001: Shota, do you have any plans to go somewhere during summer vacation?
Yeah, I'm thinking of going to Hokkaido.
Nice! What are you most looking forward to in Hokkaido?
I guess the seafood is the best part.
True, Hokkaido's seafood is really delicious.
Yuki, if you'd like, why don't you come along?
002: Have you made your travel plans yet?
I haven't decided anything at all yet.
Then why not at least decide where you want to go?
Yeah. I'm torn between Okinawa and Kyoto.
They're both great places, aren't they?
Yeah, that's why it's even harder to decide.
003: Have you booked your plane tickets yet?
No, I'm still checking the prices.
The sooner you book, the cheaper it is.
Really? Then I'll decide by the end of this week.
I think that's a good idea.
Thanks. I really appreciate the advice.
004: Where are you staying at a hotel during the trip?
I'm thinking of staying at a business hotel near the station.
Being near the station is convenient, isn't it?
Yeah, it makes getting around easier.
Did you choose a plan with breakfast included?
Yeah, I went with one that has it.
005: If you go to Kyoto, where do you want to visit?
I definitely want to go to Kiyomizu-dera and Fushimi Inari.
Also, I want to see the bamboo grove in Arashiyama.
I heard the bamboo grove is really beautiful.
006: Have you packed your bags for the trip yet?
Not yet. I'm not sure what I should bring.
You should check the weather forecast.
Yeah. If it looks like rain, I'll need an umbrella too.
Also, don't forget to bring comfortable walking shoes.
007: What are you planning to buy as souvenirs?
If it's Hokkaido, I guess sweets are the way to go.
Shiroi Koibito is pretty famous, right?
Yeah. Also, I want to buy some cheesecake.
Isn't it hard to bring back refrigerated stuff?
Hmm, I'll have to think about that.
008: Have you decided what you want to eat during the trip?
If I go to Okinawa, I can't miss goya champuru.
Also, I want to try taco rice.
All Okinawan food is so good, it's hard to choose.
009: How much are you thinking of budgeting for the trip?
I'm hoping to keep it around fifty thousand yen.
In that case, transportation and lodging will take up a good chunk.
Yeah. I'll try not to splurge too much on food.
Yeah, you'll have to balance things out.
010: Have you decided on the dates for the trip?
I'm planning to go for three days starting August tenth.
That's a good time. But it's probably going to be really crowded.
Yeah. I need to book the hotel early.
Yeah, popular places fill up fast.
Right. I'll make the reservation by the end of this week.
